notes: ἔμφοβος γενόμενος split under rule 2 rather than bundled, and both σου pronouns being free empties both governing articles under rule 20.
ἔμπροσθεν is rendered by the single word 'before', so rule 71's frame question does not arise; ἀτενίσας keeps the supplied object and possessive as rule 7 helpers, headed on the verb word.
